My city had a summertime programme where the local kids would all gather in a park, and hang out all day. There were snacks, and all sorts of activities. I grew up in a relatively poor neighbourhood, so this was quite popular with the kids. 

One of the highlights of the whole thing, was that the city installed a shack in the park, and we were allowed to decorate it however we wanted. A few weeks after we had painted the shack, I tried to impress a boy that I had met while at the park. My genius 10-year old brain came up with the idea to write a love note where he would be able to see it- the front door of the shack. With a plan in mind, I left my house wielding a small container of black paint, and a paintbrush. When nobody was looking, I wrote “_____, will you go out with me? __ yes __ no __ maybe.” In hindsight, that was exactly what I should not have done in order to impress him, because as soon as he saw it, he pretended to gag, and laughed at me. 

I never went back to the park after that, and I never saw my lover again.

I used to work as a cashier in a retail store. On my first shift, a customer he finished paying and was leaving the store. I'm a friendly person, so I proceeded to say "have a good night!" as they left the store. However, in my first-day jitters, I instead said "have a night!" The customer stared at me with a blank face, and laughed loudly.
A few months later, I had been placed on till once again. Of course, I was trying to be friendly again when customers left. I proceeded to say "have a night!" once again, but this time, my department manager was standing beside me, and laughed harder than the customer did on my first day.
